comments.value: This isn’t a duplicate suggestion. I’m talking about the fixed top official featured portal inside the Home spawn lobby. It never swaps out the same map for months, so I just want an auto rotation function for this specific pinned spot.

details:
Current Problem

 

The official pinned featured world slot in the Home spawn lobby stays locked to a single map for weeks, sometimes months, with zero rotation. This leads to a range of persistent bad user experiences:

 

1. New players are only exposed to one world on launch. They falsely assume this is the main social hub of VRChat and overlook countless high-quality, well-liked community worlds of all genres.

​

2. The permanently pinned world hits its 80-player cap constantly. Overcrowding triggers severe frame drops, lag, extended loading screens, and frequent crashes especially for Quest users.

​

3. Dedicated world creators miss critical front-page exposure. Even highly rated, consistently populated custom worlds never get featured, killing motivation to update and create new content long-term.

​

4. Veteran players lose exploration incentive. Seeing the identical pinned map every login makes the platform feel stale and repetitive over time.

 

Feature Request

 

Implement an automatic scheduled rotation system exclusively for the Home lobby’s top pinned featured world slot:

 

1. Rotate a curated pool of well-performing community worlds on an adjustable fixed timer (24/48/72 hour cycles as options).

​

2. Retain the existing featured portal UI entirely; only automate map swaps based on the rotation timer, no major interface redesign required.

​

3. Curate the rotation pool to prioritize worlds with steady player counts, high user ratings, and actively updating creators.

​

4. Include limited-time seasonal and event worlds within the pool while their events are live for timely themed variety.

 

Benefits for VRChat, Creators & All Players

 

1. Natural player traffic distribution across multiple top worlds to ease overcrowding, frame lag, and device crashes.

​

2. Fair, equal front-page visibility for more map creators to grow their communities sustainably.

​

3. Daily fresh featured content to retain long-term players and boost platform engagement.

​

4. Broaden new players’ first impression of VRChat, letting them discover diverse scene types beyond a single fixed world.

​

5. Minimal backend and performance overhead; this only requires simple timed asset swapping for the featured UI panel, with no extra server load.
title: Rotate Fixed Featured World in Starting Home Regularly
